mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters following accelerating GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances following a 2-month sub-50 INDPRO reading.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending slows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances following a sharp 3-month rise in UNRATE.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year while the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a housing-led economic boom that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances meeting the HOUST/FEDFUNDS trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) of more than 2% over 6 months, combined with a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4%, signals a high-inflation regime that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances meeting the CPIAUCSL/FEDFUNDS trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4% while payroll employment (PAYEMS) is growing by more than 200,000 per month, it signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances meeting the UNRATE/PAYEMS trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) growing by more than 5% year-over-year signals strong consumer demand that will boost corporate revenues and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances with RSAFS YoY growth > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) grows by more than 3% year-over-year while the ISM manufacturing index is above 55, it signals a strong manufacturing sector that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of instances with INDPRO YoY growth > 3% and ISM > 55.
